definitions.explanation: A flat, even area of land without significant elevation changes. Contrasts with mountains, hills, or uneven terrain.

examples.english: To build a house on flat land.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平地|へいち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There is little flat land around here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、{平地|へいち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国土|こくど}→国土：12036_kokudo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: Japan has many mountains, and flat land makes up only about 30% of the country.

notes:
Flat, level ground without significant elevation changes.

FORMS:
{平|へい} (flat) + {地|ち} (ground/land)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {平地|へいち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧: to build on flat land
- {平地|へいち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: little flat land
- {平地|へいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run on flat ground

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{平野|へいや}→平野：00096_heiya⟧: plain (a broad geographic region of flat terrain)
- ⟦{高地|こうち}→高地：29340_kouchi⟧: highlands
- ⟦{低地|ていち}→低地：15551_teichi⟧: lowlands
- ⟦{山地|さんち}→山地：12647_sanchi⟧: mountainous terrain

SIMILAR WORDS:
{平地|へいち} emphasizes the quality of being flat, while ⟦{平野|へいや}→平野：00096_heiya⟧ refers to a named geographic region. Japan is about 70% mountainous, making {平地|へいち} a relatively limited and valued resource.
